parts.name: Foot Pad
parts.Basic_description: The foot pad of the trashcan is a small metallic pedal located at the bottom front, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to open the lid of the trashcan hands-free by pressing it with the foot, activating a lever mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves in a downward direction when pressed and returns to its original position when released.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a circular metallic cover attached to the top of the trashcan, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the opening of the trashcan to contain odors and conceal waste, opening when the foot pad is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward around a hinge axis when the foot pad is pressed and closes by gravity or spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical container of the trashcan, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main compartment for holding waste and supports the lid and foot pedal mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides structural stability for the entire trashcan.
